description: Integration (a): inventory:read without asset:read scanning an asset serial, then tag, gets none with no asset in the payload.
Integration (b): code matching a product and an unreadable asset returns a plain product result, not multi.
Integration (c): asset:read plus a bundle narrowing to one client drops the other client's asset, keeps readable assets (enterprise kernel).
Integration (d): asset:read with record access keeps today's asset and multi results.
Unit: omitting the visibility argument returns no assets.
Unit: multi collapses to product/unit, and asset to none, when assets are removed; partial removal keeps readable assets.
Mobile: ScanResultCard renders multi without assets and none without candidates.
Contract tests for assetActions updated for the moved helper.
